question: According to Sikh literature, the birth anniversary of Guru Nanak Dev is celebrated on the full moon day of the Indian lunar month ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is **Kartik**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Guru Nanak Dev Ji** is the founder of Sikhism and the first of the ten Sikh Gurus.
 
• His birth anniversary is celebrated as **Guru Nanak Gurpurab** across the globe.
 
• The celebration occurs on the **full moon day (Purnima)** of the **Kartik** month in the Hindu
